definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to bend or change easily; the ability to adapt to different circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Their way of thinking lacks flexibility.

examples.japanese: {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。

notes:
Formed from ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧ (flexible) + {性|せい} (quality/nature). Can refer to both physical flexibility (of the body) and mental or organizational flexibility.

- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}: body flexibility

- ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}: flexibility of thinking
